### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/plugin-email`, `@objectstack/service-settings`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **7** documentable anchor(s).

**4** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/data-modeling/drivers.mdx`  _(via SettingsService (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/kernel/cluster.mdx`  _(via SettingsService (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/config-resolution.mdx`  _(via SettingsService (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/index.mdx`  _(via SettingsService (symbol, a top-level class))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **176** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json dc66d3308271f3055308c5c982ebc8d53195065f` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `410a590091463afe0c17a80e13fe0b682eda6f0c` — the merge of head `9e70d11b5a453c4a787655c649a0284c4f29f896` into base `dc66d3308271f3055308c5c982ebc8d53195065f`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 410a590091463afe0c17a80e13fe0b682eda6f0c && git checkout 410a590091463afe0c17a80e13fe0b682eda6f0c
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin dc66d3308271f3055308c5c982ebc8d53195065f 9e70d11b5a453c4a787655c649a0284c4f29f896 && git checkout -B drift-repro dc66d3308271f3055308c5c982ebc8d53195065f && git merge --no-ff 9e70d11b5a453c4a787655c649a0284c4f29f896

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json dc66d3308271f3055308c5c982ebc8d53195065f
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs dc66d3308271f3055308c5c982ebc8d53195065f` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对

**L1 verdict: ACCEPT** · PR #34731 · card #32799 (Fixes) · first review · L1-c2 of seat repo:objectstack#2 · read 2026-11-17T09:41Z

Head-sha: `9e70d11b5a453c4a787655c649a0284c4f29f896` (the head of final-head comment 6944281272)

Read from GitHub and the diff at this head (merge base `dc66d330`), not from the report. 9 files, +110/−25.

**Shape and ruling**
- The PR is a draft against `main` and opens with `Fixes #32799`, which is right because ruling C (6942903820) is implemented in full.
- The ui half belongs to a separate card, by the ruling's own text ("另立 ui 卡改 `isMailDelivering`", seat analysis 6931556929).
- The changeset is `patch` on the three touched published packages and carries `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: none`. With no `Metadata-protocol` kind and no narrowing, no `Skills-docs:` line is owed. `git grep` of `skills/` also finds no page on `live.provider` or `/api/settings/mail`.

**Code**
- **`judgeLiveValue`** adds exactly one admitted combination, `source === 'environment' && value === null`. It sits after the `'none'` arm and before the option-table check. `settings` + `null` still drops ("not one of its options"). A key with no option table still drops earlier. No free text can ride the new arm, since `value` is `null`.
- **`describeLiveMailTransport`** adds one branch, `else if (!option && origin === 'environment')`. A stock transport still states its option. A `settings` origin with no option, and no origin, still state nothing.
- **Spec.** `SettingsNamespacePayloadSchema.live` changes only its docblock and the two `.describe()` strings. The zod shape (`string().nullable()`, the three-value enum) is unchanged, so every payload served before still parses. The generated `settings-manifest.mdx` rows equal the new describes byte for byte.

**Pins.** The changed existing test is split exactly as the body says.
- The host's own transport now asserts `live` = `{ provider: { value: null, source: 'environment' } }` through the served door, with the banner unchanged.
- The swapped-transport half keeps "not stated", plus a host transport swapped through `setTransport`.
- A new unit pin covers `environment` only, not `settings`, and not with no origin.
- service-settings pins the served `environment` + `null` with no warn, and drops it on a key with no option table.
- The spec test parses `environment` + `null`.
- The ablations (judge line 1/24 red, plugin branch 2/21 red) are lane-reported, and I did not re-run them.

**Prose.** I checked the changeset sentence by sentence against the diff. "`settings` with a `null` value is still dropped, and so is any entry on a key with no option table" and "A transport swapped in through `EmailService.setTransport` is still not stated" both match the code and pins. "A reader that took `value === null` to mean 'nothing is in use' should read `source` instead" is the widening's one reader-facing duty.

**Consumer read (not a REWORK item; the ruling assigns it).** Two in-repo readers still hold the old meaning:
- `ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/types.ts` documents "`null` exactly when `source` is `'none'`".
- `firstRunChecklistLogic.ts` `isMailDelivering` reads `environment` + `null` as not delivering.

On the managed profile the mail row stays hidden while not delivering, so nothing new shows there. On a self-hosted deployment with a host transport class, the row reads "not set up" until the ui card lands. Before this PR, such a deployment fell back to `isMailConfigured(values)`. The row is optional (`OPTIONAL_ROWS`), so it holds nothing open. The body says the seat files the ui card. Its number belongs in the body before landing.

**Gates**: 76 check-runs on this head, all `completed`: 62 `success`, 14 `skipped`, 0 failed. That includes the re-runs of `Check Changeset` and `PR-body guards` after the 09:37Z body edit. The lane reports: package suites green (service-settings 1516, plugin-email 1025, spec `src/system` 2577), typecheck 0, and `dispatch-gates --ran` 117 run, 0 NOT MEASURED.

**L2 owed: yes.** It touches `packages/spec/src` (the `.describe()` text is shipped bytes) and declares `Clause-②: yes`, so `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` is owed over the spec hit plus the code that implements it, through this account's review seat. The lane reports it sent.

**Landing tier**: NOT governed, +110/−25 = 135 lines. It touches `packages/spec/src`, so under the seat's 03:21Z order it lands **Tier H via the seat** and stays draft.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `9e70d11b5a453c4a787655c649a0284c4f29f896`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/system/settings-manifest.zod.ts + packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-service.ts, packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-service.types.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/live-transport-status.ts

Inputs read: card #32799 body and all 14 comments (ruling 6942903820 = C, seat analysis 6931556929, cloud confirm 6918167282, dev report 6944198803); PR #34731 body and its 9-file net diff against merge base `dc66d330`; the check-runs on the head. Check-runs: 76 listed, no failure, no cancellation; every derived family (Lint and Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Type Check UI, Test Core, Test UI, Build Core, Build Docs, Spec property liveness, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards) concluded success, the rest skipped by design. `Check Changeset` concluded success twice on this head; a third run of it, started after a PR-body edit, was still in progress when read and is reported as pending, not as a verdict.

### ① Derived judgments

- Zod shape of `SettingsNamespacePayloadSchema.live`: unchanged. The diff moves only the docblock and the two `.describe()` strings; `value` stays `z.string().nullable()` (re-flowed over three lines, same chain), `source` stays `z.enum(['settings', 'environment', 'none'])`, the record and `.optional()` are untouched. The schema's accept set is identical before and after: `{ value: null, source: 'environment' }` already parsed on main (the new spec test only pins that). Right.
- Served set of `GET /api/settings/:namespace` (`judgeLiveValue`): grows by exactly one combination, `value === null` with `source === 'environment'`, on a key the namespace declares and that has an option table. Read line by line at head: the key check and the no-option-table check still run first (so `openai_model` with environment and null is still dropped, pinned); the source must be in the closed set; `none` is judged before the new line and is unchanged; the new line is a strict `source === 'environment' && value === null`; everything else falls to the unchanged `typeof value !== 'string' || table.judge(value) !== null` drop. So `settings` with null is still dropped (pinned), `undefined` is still dropped, an empty string is judged against the option table exactly as before, and a null carries no text, so the no-credential rule holds. Nothing accepted before is refused now; nothing beyond the one combination is newly accepted. Right.
- `describeLiveMailTransport` (plugin-email): emits the combination only when `isConfigured()` is true (live transport is not a `LogTransport`), no stock class names the transport (`providerOptionOf` is undefined), and the origin is `environment`. In `email-plugin.ts` (read, not in the diff) the origin is `environment` only for the transport installed at init and only while `service.options.transport` is still that same object; a swap through `setTransport` yields no origin and stays not stated (pinned both for a stock and a host transport). With no live delivery the function returns `none` before reaching the branch, so a false "in use" cannot be emitted from a log transport. Stock transports read as before (the first arm is untouched). Right.
- Describes, docblock and service-settings jsdoc against ruling C: the ruling admits one reading, "in use, provided by the environment" as `environment` with an empty provider, with in-use read from `source` (seat analysis 6931556929, option C). The `value` describe, the `source` describe ("its own boot environment or host"), the `live` docblock, `SettingsLiveValue` and `SettingsLiveStatus.values` all state that and nothing wider; each says `settings` always names an option. Right.
- `content/docs/references/system/settings-manifest.mdx`: the two regenerated cells are the two describe strings verbatim; the `live` row itself is unchanged, as its describe is. Consistent (generated output, checked for agreement only).
- Public type surface: `LiveMailProviderValue` and `SettingsLiveValue` keep their types; only prose moves. Right.

### ② Semver level

Clause-②: yes (widening) — correct, and the same line stands on the PR body and in the changeset body. The schema's accept set does not move; what widens is the set the settings route serves (one more `live` entry) and with it the meaning a reader of `value: null` must handle. Nothing is taken away, so `(narrowing)` does not apply. `Metadata-protocol: none` is correct: `live` is a served runtime statement, not something a metadata author writes. By AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist 3, kind `none` takes `patch` and a non-protocol widening ships `patch`: `@objectstack/spec` patch (published describes change), `@objectstack/service-settings` patch, `@objectstack/plugin-email` patch all match what the diff publishes. The changeset body carries the reader's prescription (read `source`, never `value === null`). `Check Changeset` success on this head (latest re-run pending, see above).

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev `open_questions` (6944198803): "Contract review owed" — answered by this record.
- Dev deviation, forced test change (the plugin-email pin split in two, the host-own half now asserting the new entry): required by ruling C; the not-stated half is kept and extended. Accepted.
- Dev deviation, `(widening)` arm added to the claim's bare `Clause-②: yes`: same declaration, arm judged correct in ②. Accepted.
- Dev out-of-scope finding (console `isMailDelivering` reads environment with null as not done; `ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/types.ts` still says "null exactly when source is none"): the ui half is outside this claim by the ruling's own execution line ("另立 ui 卡"); the PR body names the follow-up as #34749 (named there, not read here — outside this brief's inputs). Consumer read on main, see ④.
- SQL push-down: not applicable. The diff adds no query, no id materialisation and no in-app join; it is one in-memory branch in a judge and one in a describer.

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/spec/src/system/settings-manifest.zod.ts` — holds against ruling C and against its first consumer. The text says exactly what the judge serves and what plugin-email emits; the "non-null value is always one of the key's options, never a credential" sentence stays true because the null arm bypasses the option table only for null. The `settings`-always-names-an-option sentence is a served-door guarantee (the judge), not a parse-time one, the same standing the existing "no value under none" rule has; the ruling asked for an unchanged shape, so no refinement is owed.

`settings-service.ts` / `settings-service.types.ts` — agree with the contract sentence by sentence (see ①). Tried: null under `settings`, null under `none` with a value, `undefined`, empty string, a key without an option table, a key outside the namespace, a source outside the set; each lands where it did on main.

`live-transport-status.ts` — agrees. Tried: log transport (reads `none`), stock transport from boot (option with `environment`), host transport then a settings save (stock with `settings`), host transport then a failed save (`keepPreviousTransport` keeps an `environment` origin, and the host transport is in fact still delivering, so the statement is true), host transport swapped by another caller (not stated). The cloud case of 6918167282 (a plain `IEmailTransport` as the constructor default) is the pinned served-door test.

Consumers of `live` on main: only the console, `ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/firstRunChecklistLogic.ts` (`isMailDelivering`, `aiProviderState`) and `FirstRunChecklist.tsx`. Neither crashes: the type was already `string | null` and both guard with `typeof value === 'string'`; `Type Check UI` and `Test UI` are green on the head. Effect of this PR alone on the mail row: before, the absent statement fell back to `isMailConfigured(values)`; now the stated entry reads not done. On a hosted environment both read not delivering and the managed profile keeps the row hidden, so nothing visible changes until the ui card lands; the checklist does not tick yet, which the PR body states.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

- N1 (nit) — one edge moves the wrong way until the ui follow-up: a deployment on a host-own transport whose saved mail values satisfy `isMailConfigured` but could not be built (the previous transport is kept) read done through the fallback and now reads not done. Optional row, rare state, closed by the ui follow-up the PR names. Left as a follow-up; no change on this head.
- N2 (nit) — `aiProviderState` maps environment with null to `{ done: false, source: 'none' }`, which contradicts the new "read in-use from source" rule. No runtime emits that entry for `ai` today, so nothing is misread now. The ui follow-up should cover `aiProviderState` and the `types.ts` doc as well as `isMailDelivering`. Left as a follow-up; no change on this head.

- 改了什么：宿主自己交给 plugin-email 的投递方式(选项表里没有名字，比如托管平台代发通道),现在在 `GET /api/settings/mail` 上报为「在用、来自运行环境、选项表叫不出名」(`{ value: null, source: 'environment' }`)。spec 只改 `live` 的说明文字，形状不变;service-settings 只多放行这一种组合。

### ⛔ merge queue 构建失败 — 先分诊，再决定要不要重排

队列构建 [44064296349](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/44064296349) 红了。队列跑的是**全量**套件（PR 侧 CI 只跑 affected 子集），
所以失败的测试可能在本 PR 没碰过的包里 —— 那不是重排能修的。每次盲目重排都会让排在后面的所有 PR 重建一轮。

**分类：`failure`** —— 按下面的日志分诊。

**失败的 job（日志抽取，best effort）：**

- **[Test Core (3/8)](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/44064296349/job/133975224340)** — 失败步骤: Run this shard's tests

  ```
  @objectstack/runtime:test:  FAIL   local  src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-artifact-door.test.ts > [#34040 item 4] the bare doc doors beside two enabled holders of one doc name, 'alpha registered firs
    ↳ 失败原因: @objectstack/runtime:test: AssertionError: {"type":"doc","name":"shared_doc","code":{"name":"shared_doc","label":"alpha doc","content":"# alpha","_packageId":"com.qa.alpha","_packageVersion":"1.0.0","
  @objectstack/runtime:test:  FAIL   local  src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-artifact-door.test.ts > [#34040 item 4] the bare doc doors beside two enabled holders of one doc name, 'beta registered first
    ↳ 失败原因: @objectstack/runtime:test: AssertionError: {"type":"doc","name":"shared_doc","code":{"name":"shared_doc","label":"beta doc","content":"# beta","_packageId":"com.qa.beta","_packageVersion":"1.0.0","_pr
  ```

> `↳ 失败原因` 是判读的关键：**超时**（`Test timed out in …` / `Hook timed out in …`）多半是负载/时序，不是本 PR 的回归；
> **断言**（`AssertionError: …`）才指向真实的行为改变。两者的 `FAIL` 行长得一模一样，只有这一行能区分。
>
> ⚠️ **断言这一侧有一类例外，判据是断言在测什么，不是它是不是 `AssertionError`。** 断言的对象是**产品行为**（一个值、一个形状、一次拒收）⇒ 照上面读：真实的行为改变，去查，⛔ 不要重排掉；
> 断言的对象是**这次实验自身的有效性前提**（跑完的耗时、负载下的先后、任何只在时间预算内才成立的条件）⇒ 它跟**超时**是同一类，同样对负载敏感，重排一次是合法的判别手段。
